_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermo#5, and the execution that FALSIFIED its wording. The entry claimed a wrong eletype in THERMO ELEMENTS 'triggers element-spec mismatch from core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp' — i.e. that the section gates the element category. It does not. '1 TRANSP HEX8 ... MAT 1' is rejected only because a TRANSP-specific key is missing ("Required value 'TYPE' not found in input line"); add 'TYPE Std' and the scalar-transport element is ACCEPTED into the 'thermo' discretisation, survives fill_complete, and the run then dies with an uncaught Teuchos::Exceptions::InvalidParameterType naming FourC::ScaTra::Action — SIGABRT, exit 134, and zero 4C error blocks (TYPED_TRANSP_FOURC_ERROR_BLOCK=0). A genuinely bad celltype is caught, but by 4C_fem_general_cell_type_traits.hpp ('Unknown celltype HEX9'), not by the input-spec builder the entry named. ELEMENT_CATEGORY_COMPLAINT=0 pins that no arm ever says the element does not belong in this section. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
